items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 96:1
items.html: The third aspect in the soul of Adam HaRishon, which is the general lower nine Sefirot, similar to the aspect of the ZAT of Nekudim that spread in their reign down to BYA, came out with the eating of the Tree of Knowledge, as above in Answer 146. But they were flawed immediately as they came out, for they fell at once to the Klipot, as above, similar to the ZAT that fell to BYA at once with their reign. Understand this. (Ibid.)
